description: Audit one Docker Compose file and resolve its internal references. Reports two services publishing the same host port, where only one can bind; a named volume or network mounted and never declared; a dependency on a service this file does not define; a depends_on with no condition, so Compose waits for the container to start rather than for the service to be ready; and a wait for a service with no healthcheck, which can never be satisfied. Pay 150000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

compose.description: The Compose file. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
compose.example:
services:
  api:
    image: ghcr.io/example/api:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - cache:/var/cache
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      MODE: production
      LOG_LEVEL: debug
  worker:
    image: ghcr.io/example/worker:1.4.0
    ports:
      - published: 8080
        target: 9000
    environment:
      - SECRET_KEY
      - MODE=production
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    volumes:
      - /var/lib/postgresql/data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

environment_names.description: The environment variable names services are permitted to set. Omitted means that comparison is reported as not done.

name: docker_compose_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when the file parsed and every check that ran found nothing.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Docker Compose Contract Audit
